name: Together AI
description: Together AI's pricing page covers serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning and GPU clusters, with a 'Start for free' option.
features: Dedicated inference per GPU per hour
useCases: Running open models through an API
strengths: Per-token pricing is published for each model
Dedicated and reserved options for steady workloads
limitations: A free-credit amount is not stated on the page we read
Prices are per model and change by model

plans.name: Serverless inference
plans.note: Per 1M tokens (input and output); some models also show cached-input rates. Image, video and audio models are priced per image, video, minute or character

plans.name: Dedicated inference
plans.note: Per GPU per hour, on-demand or reserved

plans.name: GPU clusters
plans.note: Per GPU per hour, on-demand or reserved by duration

plans.name: Fine-tuning
plans.note: Per 1M tokens based on training dataset size multiplied by epochs, with per-model minimum charges

free.details: A 'Start for free' option is shown; the credit amount and limits are not stated. Some models are listed at $0.00.

api.summary: Examples per 1M tokens (input / output): Kimi K3 $3.00 / $15.00 ($0.30 cached input); GLM-5.3-Flash $0.15 / $0.50 ($0.03 cached input); gpt-oss-120B $0.15 / $0.60.

notes: Enterprise and reserved capacity are arranged through sales. Regional and tax notes: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Serverless rates per 1M tokens are listed per model (for example Kimi K3 $3.00 input / $15.00 output; GLM-5.3-Flash $0.15 / $0.50; gpt-oss-120B $0.15 / $0.60). Dedicated, cluster and fine-tuning prices and any free credit were not re-read, so the record stays partial.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

keyFeature: Inference, fine-tuning and GPU clusters for open models
